summary: Genprex, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing a collaboration with Roche Diagnostics on August 3, 2026, to validate TROP2 as a biomarker for patient selection in non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) trials. The collaboration builds on preclinical and clinical data linking high TROP2 and low PTEN H-scores to improved progression-free survival. Roche will perform assay validation using its TROP2 antibody, expected by end of 2026, followed by integration into Genprex's NSCLC clinical program. No deal terms, prices, or strategic transactions were disclosed, making this a routine operational announcement.
